words.sense: Richly productive or capable of generating abundant life or ideas; particularly fertile.
misconceptions: Any creator who has published lots must be described in terms of fertility.

words.sense: Producing an unusually large number of works, results, or outputs.
misconceptions: Rich capacity counts only after many finished works exist.

semantic_axes.description: Whether the emphasis is on fruitful generative capacity or on many demonstrated outputs.

edges.boundary_rule: Fecund emphasizes richly fertile generative power; prolific emphasizes a record of producing many results.
clues_a: wide range of ideas readily arising

misconceptions.M1: Any creator who has published lots must be described in terms of fertility.
misconceptions.M2: Rich capacity counts only after many finished works exist.
misconceptions.M3: An award or reputation is equivalent to producing many items.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the soil in Maya’s new garden?

beats.text: A handful of Maya’s dark, crumbly soil holds worms and sends up shoots wherever she plants seeds.
beats.reason: The situation shows soil supports vigorous growth, which points to fecund.

beats.text: Even seeds she scattered without planning have taken root in several corners.
beats.decisive_clue: many kinds of seeds readily grow in that soil
beats.reason: The focus is the soil’s productive richness, not a tally of finished works.

chains.feedback_short: Many kinds of seeds readily grow in that soil: fecund fits better.
chains.feedback_deep: Fecund emphasizes richly fertile generative power; prolific emphasizes a record of producing many results. Here, the focus is the soil’s productive richness, not a tally of finished works.
chains.contrast_rule: Fecund is rich in creative or natural power; prolific has plenty to show for it.

hints.attention: Think about what the soil enables.
hints.axis: Whether the emphasis is on fruitful generative capacity or on many demonstrated outputs.
hints.contrast: Fecund is rich in creative or natural power; prolific has plenty to show for it.
